name: Monastery of Batalha
description: This limestone Dominican monastery stands in central Portugal, built to give thanks for the 1385 victory over Castile at Aljubarrota. Work continued for roughly two centuries, producing a distinctive Portuguese Gothic style with lacelike stonework. Its Royal Cloister, richly carved in the Manueline manner, is the highlight, and the church also serves as the burial place of the Aviz dynasty's kings.
